notes.title: Post-launch patch 1.2
notes.content:
[b]Second patchnote:[/b]
- Fixed some errors in the text.
- Fixed minor errors on the backgrounds.
- Added a little more variability in blink timings.
- Deleted overly explicit scenes.
Due to age rating issues in the European region and Brazil, we have decided to remove it. But don't worry, all LORE info has been moved to another scenes.

Report the bug: thetenebraestudio@gmail.com

notes.title: 1001 sales with patch 1.1!
notes.content:
[h2]We are glad that our debut game has resonated in the hearts of many players. Over 1000 sales already![/h2]

[b]Here is the first patch to improve the comfort of the game.[/b]

- Added color indication in dialogs.
- Corrected text errors.
- Slightly changed the color of clouds.
- Made some endings slightly harder to get.
- Slightly darkened the dialog box.
- “Pink Morning” will now only be shown once, if conditions are met.

Report the bug: thetenebraestudio@gmail.com

notes.title: MOOD - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[h1]Today's the day.🔥[/h1]
[b]MOOD is out now![/b] After 3 years of development, phew. With a [b]10%[/b] launch discount running for the first week!

[h1]What's the game about, anyway?[/h1]
Lively dialogs. Gloomy slavic atmosphere. [b]A dope girl with horns. [/b]

[h1]How you can support us?[/h1]
[list]
[*] 📢 [b]Write a Steam review[/b] – A ve-e-ery important thing to to make the game more visible! Every review is important!
[*] 📢 [b]Like and share.[/b]
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566880/MOOD/
Report bugs - thetenebraestudio@gmail.com
